title: True two-image fusion with contribution guarding and clearer copy

requirements.summary: Make on-device fusion outputs true two-image composites via localized region mixing and edge-aware blending (not mostly global color/overlay edits).
acceptanceCriteria: Generating fusion outputs produces images where both Photo A and Photo B are visibly represented (not just a tint/temperature shift of one photo).
At least one fusion technique used by the generator performs localized region mixing (not a full-frame uniform blend) and uses edge-aware blending/feathering to avoid harsh seams.
The fusion pipeline reduces reliance on global hue rotation/saturation/noise as the primary differentiator between outputs.

file_operations.description: Replace the current mostly per-pixel full-frame blend pipeline with a true two-image fusion pipeline that includes (1) patch/region-based mixing between Photo A and Photo B (e.g., randomized grid/patch sampling, multi-scale patches, and/or saliency/gradient-informed patch selection) and (2) edge-aware blending/feathering (e.g., gradient-mask based alpha, distance-transform feathering near patch borders, or simple seam smoothing) to avoid harsh seams; reduce the role of global hue/saturation/noise so they are optional minor finishing steps rather than the main differentiator.

Implement reusable on-device fusion utilities for localized region mixing (patch selection, multi-scale region replacement, mask generation) and edge-aware blending/feathering to combine patches from both inputs into a coherent composite; keep the implementation Canvas/ImageData-based and fully in-browser (no external services).

Add edge-aware blending helpers (e.g., compute simple gradient magnitude maps, generate soft masks around patch borders, and apply feathered alpha compositing) used by the fusion generator to reduce seams while preserving structure from both inputs.

requirements.summary: Add an on-device contribution guard that detects near-duplicates of either input and automatically retries with different fusion recipes/seeds, failing with a clear English error after max retries.
acceptanceCriteria: If a generated output is too similar to either input image, the app automatically retries generation rather than returning the near-duplicate result.
After exhausting retries, the user sees an English error explaining that the app could not produce a valid fusion from the chosen photos and suggesting trying different photos.
Regenerating a hidden output also uses the contribution guard and does not return near-duplicates of either input.

file_operations.description: Implement a similarity check that flags outputs that are effectively Photo A or Photo B with only minor global changes (e.g., downsampled luminance/edge-map comparison, MSE/SSIM-like heuristic, and thresholds) and returns a pass/fail signal plus optional diagnostics; keep everything on-device using Canvas/ImageData.

Integrate the both-inputs contribution guard into generation: after each candidate fusion is produced, compare it against both inputs; if too similar to either input, automatically retry with a different fusion recipe/seed up to a maximum retry count; if still failing, throw a clear English error message indicating a valid fusion could not be produced and suggesting trying different photos.

Ensure UI error handling surfaces the contribution-guard failure message clearly in English (via existing toast/error display) when max retries are exhausted, without adding new workflow steps; confirm hidden-output regeneration continues to call the same generator path so the guard applies there as well. Use existing shadcn-ui components already present in the page (Alert/Card/Tabs/Button); verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update Upload/Generate page copy to define fusion as a combined result derived from BOTH photos (not a filter) and align labels/descriptions accordingly.
acceptanceCriteria: The Upload/Generate page describes fusion as combining/merging two photos into one new output and explicitly indicates both photos contribute.
All updated copy is in English and does not reference single-photo variation generation.

file_operations.description: Revise user-facing copy (header subtitle, section descriptions, and generate button microcopy) to plainly define 'fusion' as a new combined image built from BOTH Photo A and Photo B (not a filter); keep the existing workflow unchanged. Use existing shadcn-ui components already used on the page; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
